claims.text: Composite materials containing solid lubricants and a high-temperature-stable matrix can achieve stable tribological performance across a wide temperature range.
The proposed material design combines solid lubricants with a high-temperature-stable matrix.
The intended operating environment includes high temperatures, a wide temperature range, and extreme mechanical-system conditions.
Alloying and composite formation provide the structural mediator of the intervention.
Composition changes can balance mechanical strength and lubrication efficiency.
The proposed composite will improve tribological performance across a wide temperature range.
The proposed composite will improve mechanical strength across a wide temperature range.
Current high-temperature self-lubricating materials have limited mechanical strength and lubrication efficiency.
Composite performance is bounded by temperature range and mechanical load limits.
